{c_gold}I:{/c} Hurl {c_number}1{/c} flaming bolt, dealing {c_number}{payload:COMBO_1_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.
{c_gold}II:{/c} Hurl {c_number}2{/c} flaming bolts, dealing {c_number}{payload:COMBO_2_DAMAGE}{/c} damage each.
{c_gold}III:{/c} Hurl {c_number}1{/c} flaming bolt, dealing {c_number}{payload:COMBO_3_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.
{c_gold}IV:{/c} Hurl {c_number}1{/c} flaming bolt that explodes, dealing {c_number}{payload:COMBO_4_DAMAGE}{/c} damage and Burning enemies {c_number}{dot:COMBO_4_BURNING}{/c} over {c_number}{buffduration:COMBO_4_BURNING}{/c} seconds.
